idea-plugin.name: Model Sunset Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds every model ID and API parameter in your code that a vendor has already switched off or has published a date for - 109 rules across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Azure, each carrying the real shutdown date and the exact replacement string.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Model Sunset Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 109 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/model-sunset-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/model-sunset-lint

action.text: Model Sunset Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Model Sunset Lint on the file in the editor
